name: Parallel Splatting on Cray T3D
definition: A memory-optimized volume rendering method for the Cray T3D that projects voxels onto a raster using splatting, distributing data and workload across multiple Processing Elements (PEs) to render large datasets (e.g., Visible Human Project) at interactive rates.
summary: Parallel Splatting on Cray T3D is a memory-optimized volume rendering method that uses a tiling-based compositing strategy to distribute workload across Processing Elements, avoiding repeated I/O overhead on the Cray T3D.
